explanation: The curves intersect where x²+x−6=0, giving x=−3 and x=2. Throughout D, −2≤y≤5/2, so D is contained in R. Thus II and III coincide: both retain 2^(x+y) on D and set it to zero on R\D, establishing the required equality. I instead integrates over the complement of D. Therefore II and III only are valid.
